name: Sunrise Fang
source:
Matteo is one of four adventurers in the Sunrise Fang - a party travelling across the lands to protect others from evil beasts that have seemingly no end. But it is a ruthless job, and his mind seems to be lingering in the comfort of something else...

[From [url=https://hdlepre.itch.io/sunrise-fang-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
马泰奥是日出之牙的四名冒险家之一，这是一支穿越大地保护他人免受看似永无止境的邪恶野兽侵害的队伍。但这是一份无情的工作，而他的思绪似乎还沉浸在别的安逸的事情中……

[来自[url=https://hdlepre.itch.io/sunrise-fang-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
